name.la: In Actus apostolorum expositio, Retractatio, De nominibus locorum
name.en-US: On the Acts of the Apostles (with the Retractation and the Names of Places)
name.pt-BR: Sobre os Atos dos Apóstolos (com a Retratação e os Nomes dos Lugares)

description.la: Expositio super Acta apostolorum; Retractatio in Actus; De nominibus locorum, quae in Actibus apostolorum leguntur.
description.en-US: Bede's commentary on Acts, his later Retractation (a second reading of the book against the Greek text), and the short list of place-names in Acts. Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: O comentário de Beda aos Atos, a Retratação posterior (uma segunda leitura do livro à luz do texto grego) e a breve lista dos nomes de lugares nos Atos.

sources.edition: Expositio super Acta Apostolorum Beda; Retractatio in Acta Apostolorum; De nominibus locorum on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
